name: Cargo crane swing control (bench)
notes: Two sequential bench checks on one continuous timeline (no reset between them — intentional). Hoist to 10 m and traverse to x = 10 must settle within 8 s (trolley and cable on target, swing damped, load hanging at y ~= 20); then commanding a return must visibly excite the pendulum mid-transit. Tests servo motion, hoist, pendulum dynamics and the BENCH contract; looks are for the blind vote.
